Specification: This specification is a small state-space test that models a single variable x ranging over the set of all functions from 1..6 to 1..7. The initial predicate prints a status message using TLC's Print operator and then chooses any such function as the initial value of x, while the next-state relation allows only stuttering by leaving x unchanged. It defines a trivial invariant TRUE and appears intended to measure or demonstrate exploration of a large finite set of function states rather than verify a nontrivial safety or liveness property.
